# Phase 1 — Core MVP: Claude + Codex

[GENESIS §14 Phase 1](GENESIS.md). Two-adapter MVP. Crates land in dependency order: `maru-core` → `maru-store` → `maru-adapters` → `maru-activation` → `maru-cli` + `maru-shim` parallel.

Exit criteria (from GENESIS §14):

- `cargo install --path crates/maru-cli` works on macOS, Linux, Windows.
- `maru install`, `maru profile create work --harness claude,codex`, `maru profile use work`, `claude` and `codex` shims work end-to-end.
- Shim cold-start ≤ 15 ms (Linux/macOS) / ≤ 40 ms (Windows) in CI.
- Linux Claude credential gate verified by an integration test.
